endpoints.name: search_places
endpoints.label: 🔍 Search Places
endpoints.description: Search for places using free-form text input.

query_params.input: Free-form text input to search for places (string, required).
query_params.inputtype: The type of input, e.g. 'textquery' (string, required).

endpoints.name: place_details
endpoints.label: 📍 Place Details
endpoints.description: Retrieve detailed information about a place using its place_id.

query_params.place_id: The unique identifier of the place (string, required).

endpoints.name: nearby_search
endpoints.label: 📌 Nearby Search
endpoints.description: Find places within a given radius of a location.

query_params.location: Latitude/longitude around which to retrieve place information, formatted as 'lat,lng' (string, required).
query_params.radius: Distance in meters within which to return place results (integer, required).

endpoints.name: find_place
endpoints.label: 🔎 Find Place by Name or Address
endpoints.description: Search for a place using name or address.

query_params.input: The text string on which to search, e.g. a name or address (string, required).
query_params.inputtype: The type of input, e.g. 'textquery' (string, required).

query_params.input: Partial text input for autocomplete suggestions (string, required).
